title: Sneaking into nightclubs in his grandfather's clothes at sixteen
summary: At sixteen or seventeen he started in the clubs, disguised as a grown man to get past the door and begging to sing.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So then I started workin' in nightclubs, and I worked for a bunch of I-talians.
How old were you when you started workin' in the nightclubs?
I was about sixteen...seventeen years old.
I was about as tall as I am now...almost.
Now, what are you? About six, three?

I was big for my size so I used to go around... To get in the nightclub, I had to dress up like a grown person. My mother used to dress me in Buster Brown things and stuff like that. So I would get so I'd go and get my grandfather's long pants and roll 'em up and get some eyebrow pencil, make me some mustache, put on...put on my grandfather's clothes. They swallow me up but I still was dressin' like a man, and I would go sneak into the club when my brother-in-law wasn't on the door. They nailed me so they let me...I told them I was lookin' for him, so they'd let me...the man that was on the door would let me in.
So I'd go around and bug everybody, so they found out I was in there and they throw me out. So I used to go 'round and bug everybody ...listen to the music...let me sing, let me sing.
"What're you doin' here, kid? You cain't sing. You get outa here." Say, "What're you doin' with all them clothes on like that? You ain't got no business in here. You too young."
Say, "I'm old enough to be in here. Don't tell me that. I'm old enough to be in here. A lot of people in here ain't as old as me," I tell 'em, you know.
They thought I was a baaad boy. So I learnt how to get by with that. I get by with it every so often. But somebody know me come in there and tell me to hit them...I'd have to hit 'em.
"You gotta get outa here. You too young to be in here. You momma don't know you down here."
